# Lucy

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 c19 P41](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0041)</sub>

## Appearance

She is a young girl, the twin sister of Robin. She attends school alongside her brother and sits in the classroom among the younger students.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v3 c11 P56](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0056)_

## Personality

Lucy is an exceedingly demure and soft-spoken child, often remaining exceptionally quiet compared to her peers. She can be easily frightened by dark or unsettling stories, such as tales of deceased relatives and wandering ghosts, which cause her to weep and fear being alone in the dark. Despite her timid nature, she is well-behaved, respectful, and observant of domestic and spiritual routines.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P2](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0002), [v2 c21 P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003), [v2 c21 P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v3 c11 P56](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0056)_

## Traits

- Demure  <sub>[v2 c21 P2](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0002)</sub>
- Quiet  <sub>[v2 c21 P2](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0002)</sub>
- Fearful of the dark  <sub>[v2 c21 P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003)</sub>
- Fearful of ghosts  <sub>[v2 c21 P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007)</sub>

## History

Lucy was brought to live at Grey Shutters alongside her twin brother, Robin, under the care of Nell Harcourt and Thirza Abernethy. Before starting school, she agreed at Sunday School to sit with Lily Mott, though she was provisionally placed next to Mirabel Cotton on her first day. At school, Mirabel frightened Lucy with detailed stories of her deceased family members and a ghost uncle, leaving Lucy terrified to go upstairs in the dark alone at night until Nell comforted her. Nell later promised to take Lucy and Robin on a boat ride to the dunes for a shore picnic.

_Sources: [v2 c16 P37](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0037), [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 c21 P2](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0002), [v2 c21 P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003), [v2 c21 P5](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0005), [v2 c21 P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v3 c11 P56](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0056)_
